envelope.description: Move the keys handlers and other users onto the vault

body.title: Move the keys handlers and other users onto the vault
body.summary: Make keys.list read through the vault, make keys.get use a null check so an empty saved secret exists, confirm notify, web and tool configuration read through the vault, document in the vault module that a remembered refusal applies during the five-minute cooldown and that legacy items are retained after copying, and refresh the pinned inventory.
acceptanceChecks: Notify, web and keys handlers read through the vault
keys.get reports exists:true for an empty saved secret
keys.set with a non-string value is refused and other secrets stay readable after a restart
The vault module documents the cooldown and the retention of legacy items
The connection-management inventory matches the changed sources

tests.name: consumers: notify, web and keys handlers read through the vault
ipc: keys.get reports exists:true for an empty saved secret
ipc: keys.set with a non-string value is refused and other secrets stay readable after a restart
live: after a node upgrade one dialog appears across several connections and threads once migration is complete
